title: Paper-ballot transition democratic impact and implementation monitor
objective: Assess whether paper-ballot voting protects equal, secret, accessible, secure and auditable elections without enabling discrimination, intimidation, selective enforcement or avoidable delay.

affected_groups.group: Voters, including disabled, low-literacy, language-minority, rural, remote and economically disadvantaged voters
affected_groups.baseline_source: Pre-transition electoral participation, complaint and service-access data, published without voter-identifying information.

affected_groups.group: Candidates, parties, polling agents, journalists and civil-society observers
affected_groups.baseline_source: Published electoral complaint, observer-access, recount and enforcement data.
Staffing, training, transfer and protected-disclosure records.

indicators.name: Ballot reconciliation completion
indicators.definition: Share of polling stations with a publicly available reconciliation of printed, issued, cancelled, tendered, spoiled, unused and counted ballots before result declaration.
indicators.data_source: Polling-station ballot account and result record
indicators.publication: Polling-station aggregate dataset and exception register
indicators.privacy_safeguard: No ballot, voter identity or vote-choice data published.

indicators.name: Accessible independent voting rate
indicators.definition: Availability and successful use of accessible ballot and independent-marking support, disaggregated by lawful access category without identifying voters.
indicators.data_source: Accessibility observation, anonymous voter survey and complaint data
indicators.independent_validation: Disabled-persons organisations and external accessibility audit
indicators.privacy_safeguard: Voluntary, aggregate and de-identified data only.

indicators.name: Count and recount timeliness
indicators.definition: Time from poll close to result, reasoned recount decision and final count record, with outliers explained.

indicators.name: Political-retaliation and selective-enforcement signal
indicators.definition: Comparator analysis of complaints, transfers, audit actions, observer restrictions and remedies by geography, allegation type and legally permitted political category.
indicators.data_source: Complaint registry, staffing record and remedy database
indicators.frequency: quarterly during election period and annually
indicators.privacy_safeguard: No voter profiling; suppress small cells.

indicators.name: Custody and intimidation incidents
indicators.definition: Reported theft, destruction, tampering, coercion, violence, ballot secrecy breach or access obstruction, with outcome and remedy.
indicators.data_source: Incident log, police/court record and protected disclosure channel
indicators.privacy_safeguard: Protect witnesses and sensitive security details.

indicators.name: Transition cost and capacity
indicators.definition: Actual versus approved cost, staffing, training completion, storage capacity and procurement variance.
indicators.data_source: Published budgets, tenders, stock and training records
indicators.frequency: monthly in transition and after each election
indicators.privacy_safeguard: No personal payroll or security-sensitive location detail.

oversight.body: Independent Review Authority supported by an external auditor selected through a published conflict-screened process
oversight.appointment_safeguard: Plural appointment, published criteria, recusal, recorded reasons, fixed terms and no executive case-specific direction
oversight.audit_frequency: Pre-transition, after each election and annually
oversight.public_report: Public report with data, methods, limitations, dissent and corrective actions
oversight.information_remedy: Court order, parliamentary referral and publication of unjustified withholding.

complaints.retaliation_protection: Independent intake, evidence preservation, interim protection within seven working days and no adverse action for a good-faith complaint
complaints.outcome_publication: Anonymised quarterly outcomes, delays and comparator data
complaints.appeal_route: Independent review, election-petition remedies and constitutional court access

triggers.condition: Any unreconciled polling-station ballot account or unexplained custody break
triggers.detector: Public account, agent objection or audit
triggers.deadline: Immediate preservation; public reasoned action within 24 hours
triggers.interim_protection: Secure ballots and prohibit declaration for the affected unit where lawful
triggers.correction: Reconciliation, supervised scrutiny/recount, referral and published result

triggers.condition: Material disparity in accessible voting or complaint remedy
triggers.interim_protection: Accessible alternative route and additional assistance
triggers.correction: Training, equipment, staffing or rule amendment; legislative referral if persistent

triggers.condition: Repeated intimidation, violence, ballot secrecy breach or selective officer transfer
triggers.responsible_body: Independent Review Authority and competent court/prosecutor
triggers.deadline: Interim protection within seven working days
triggers.interim_protection: Evidence preservation, suspension of impugned action and lawful security support
triggers.correction: Reasoned remedy, disciplinary/criminal referral under general law and public audit

triggers.condition: Cost overrun, procurement concentration or capacity failure that threatens equal voting access
triggers.deadline: Public explanation within seven days; corrective plan within 30 days
triggers.interim_protection: Neutral emergency logistics support subject to public record and review
triggers.correction: Re-tender, funding correction, audit referral or statutory amendment

review.legislative_review: After the first nationwide paper-ballot election and every five years thereafter
review.sunset_or_review_date: Exceptional transition provisions expire after the first nationwide paper-ballot election unless Parliament renews them with published evidence
review.repeal_or_amendment_route: Public evidence review, independent audit, parliamentary debate and judicial review remain available.
